iti93:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti93:2.3: The fire of passion, the fire of aversion, the fire of delusion.
iti93:3.1: The fire of passion burns in a mortal
iti93:3.3: the fire of aversion, in a malevolent person
iti93:4.1: the fire of delusion, in a bewildered person
iti93:4.4:
people
–fond of self-identity–
unreleased from Māra’s shackles,
iti93:5.3:
demons,
the realm of the hungry ghosts.
iti93:6.1:
While those who, day & night,
are devoted
iti93:6.2:
to the message
of the rightly self-awakened,
iti93:6.3: put out the fire of passion,
iti93:7.2:
put out the fire of aversion
with good will,
iti93:7.3:
and the fire of delusion
with the discernment leading
iti93:8.4:
having, without remainder,
comprehended stress,
are, without remainder,
totally unbound.
iti93:9.1:
They, the wise, with an attainer-of-wisdom’s
noble vision,
iti93:9.3:
directly knowing
the ending of birth,
